column2: You understand that you should fill this with perfect soul blood.\nMaybe have some yourself while you're at it...
Protects you from harm while powered.\nRight click while holding this to power it with 1 soul.
Strike yourself down with enough power to fully obliterate the soul.
Vanquish your expelled soul at the haunted gate.
Teach the mages about rain, and let the soul take in the magical environment.
While reaching for heaven, expel the souls of lesser creatures.
Cherish the soul with many friends.
Entertain the soul with a fight at the amphitheatre down below.
Kick the soul and the process will be complete.
You have become divine.\nHigher powers respect this, granting you access to the void's unlimited souls.
Bathe the crystal in soul blood and kick it to revive its host.
